* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ochi (Errata)]], 31 May 2022): Players Committee card image, 31 May 2022: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-ochi-20220531.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/13a5f3a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/ochi.png Holotable commit 13a5f3a “Hires sets 4, 14, 16, couple AIs”], no mark). Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page, 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V14-D-ochi.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual14-Dark/hires/ochi.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E1”). Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting Bestoon Legacy, it is immune to attrition < 5. While [Episode VII] Emperor on table, your total power here is +3. If opponent's character was just placed out of play (even from Lost Pile), opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' “just placed out of play” became “just placed out of play (even from Lost Pile)”; the card prints the errata mark “E1”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
